stages.name: Engineering baseline and lab readiness
stages.verification_note: Non-normative readiness evidence: repository validation, source digest verification, architecture decisions, and lab records.
stages.exit_gate: Every requirement has development ownership and a test/evidence state; architecture and lab decisions needed by G1 are explicit.

stages.name: P0 feasibility and core control contracts
stages.exit_gate: A real compact model and one authorized file-to-artifact workflow operate offline on the selected development tuples with bounded resource accounting and model-independent recovery.

stages.name: Ubuntu platform alpha
stages.exit_gate: T01-T16 and the real vertical workflow pass on both frozen A1 reference machines, including failed boot, model, worker and commit recovery.

stages.name: Functional beta
stages.exit_gate: The core journeys use real local inference and files, publish editable artifacts, remain accessible without inference, and recover from the defined faults.

stages.name: A1 hardening
stages.exit_gate: Complete A1 traceability, 500 held-out tasks, 300 adversarial cases, 1,000 crash trials, clean restore, external security review and a 72-hour soak pass with no severity 0 or 1 defect.

stages.name: A1 product release
stages.exit_gate: Every applicable mandatory A1 and quality result passes on the exact signed images and certified tuples; simulated evidence does not close a gate.

stages.name: Windows hosted-platform proof
stages.exit_gate: WSL starts the real core and compact inference, reads a host file through the authenticated broker, enforces confinement, and the Hyper-V desktop proof operates.

stages.name: WSL product beta
stages.window: After GWIN0 and G3; overlaps G4
stages.exit_gate: Host-file automation, outage reconciliation, update recovery, backup and cross-profile migration pass with zero unauthorized reads or lost acknowledged versions.

stages.name: Dual boot and virtual machine qualification
stages.window: After GWIN1 and the G5 A1 release
stages.exit_gate: Every announced N, D, W or V profile independently passes its inherited and profile-specific evidence gate, including real end-to-end journeys.

stages.name: A2 large local edition
stages.window: Experiments from P0; formal certification after G5, approximately months 12-16
stages.exit_gate: The declared real 400-405B package completes the suite on the measured topology; fake allocation, sparse mapping or a smaller substitute cannot pass.

stages.name: A3 distributed edition
stages.exit_gate: Trusted nodes, complete replica reservation, generation fencing, durable state and measured 2, 8 and 32 worker envelopes pass the distributed fault suite.

stages.name: Microkernel feasibility research
stages.verification_note: A numbered RX procedure must be added through requirements change control before execution.
stages.exit_gate: One reference board proves deterministic boot, storage, display/input, DMA isolation, recovery, application compatibility and real accelerator inference before product funding.

current_reference_evidence.evidence: The v0.1.0 Python reference runtime provides one grant-scoped deterministic workflow, durable artifacts and receipts, restart recovery, loopback controls and a developer WSL path. This is not product qualification.
